info.title: SmartBuy AI API
info.description: SmartBuy AI public + authenticated API (v1). Generated from the route files under app/api/ on 2026-11-13 (Section 19, Phase 9). Auth: Supabase session cookie for user endpoints; x-api-key header for /api/v1/public/* (tiers: anon 100/IP/day, Free 1,000, Premium/Family 10,000, Team 100,000 per day); Bearer <redacted> for the 6 cron endpoints; Stripe webhook signature for /api/webhooks/stripe. All 187 routes enforce rate limiting (Upstash Redis when configured, in-memory fallback). This spec lists paths and methods only — request/response schemas are not yet machine-generated; see API_DOCUMENTATION.md for the curated guide.
